title: Rabbi Nachumi, Son of Rabbi Chiya bar Abba

paragraphs: Rabbi Nahumi, son of Rabbi Hiyya bar Abba.

He learned Torah from his father, as stated at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:2. In Demai 1:2 he says, “My father had money,” etc. Hyman places him in Caesarea and identifies him as a priest, citing Nazir 7:1, folio 34b.
Berakhot 3:1, folio 20b, mentions him as Rabbi Nechemyah, son of Rabbi Chiya bar Abba.

notes.text: The Demai wording is my father had money, not a report that someone called Abba spoke. Nechemyah and Nachumi remain the notice’s forms.

The consulted Nazir 7:1 names Nichumi, son of Chiya bar Abba, reporting that his father avoided the Caesarea arch; this does not by itself explicitly state that the son lived there or was a priest. Those conclusions remain Hyman’s. Demai 1:2 prints Abba in parentheses in the corresponding report.
